text:
The plate looks like a side plate, roughly 22-23 cm across, since the outer rim spans about 525 px. That works out to about 0.042 cm per px.

The meatloaf is about 290 px long, or roughly 12 cm. Its width is about 150 px (6.5 cm), and its height is maybe 4 cm. That gives a volume of about 12 × 6.5 × 4 ≈ 300 cm³. A rounded loaf shape reduces this to about 250 cm³. At a density of about 1 g/cm³, that is about 220-250 g. Using 200 g to be conservative, at roughly 1.9 kcal/g for meatloaf with a glaze, that is about 380 kcal.

The 4 baby carrots weigh about 10 g each, so about 40 g, or roughly 15 kcal.

Total: about 240 g and about 400 kcal.
